result.instructions: Tools for Spryng, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many SMS credits do we have left?"; "Show me all messages that failed to deliver this week."; "Send 'Your appointment is tomorrow at 10:00' to 31612345678 from our clinic name.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spryng data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spryng_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spryng_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spryng_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. spryng_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spryng_get_balance
tools.title: Get SMS balance
tools.description: Return the credit balance of the Spryng account behind this key.

tools.name: spryng_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List SMS messages sent from this account, newest first by default. Filter by status (pending, sent, delivered, failed), recipient number, originator, reference, created or scheduled date range, or country code.

recipient_number.description: Recipient mobile number in international format without +, e.g. 31612345678.

originator.description: Show messages sent from this originator.

reference.description: Show messages with this client reference.

sort.description: Sort field, e.g. created_at. Prefix with ! for descending, e.g. !created_at.

tools.name: spryng_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: Return one SMS message by its Spryng id (UUID), including its status when available.

message_id.description: Message id returned by spryng_send_message or spryng_list_messages.

tools.name: spryng_list_subaccounts
tools.title: List subaccounts
tools.description: List the subaccounts of this Spryng account. Filter by active state or a username/email search string.

is_active.description: true for active subaccounts, false for inactive ones.

sort.description: Sort field, e.g. created_at. Prefix with ! for descending, e.g. !created_at.

tools.name: spryng_send_message
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: Send one SMS to up to 50 recipients. Spends credits and cannot be undone once sent. Use scheduled_at to send later (cancel with spryng_cancel_message before it is sent).

items.description: Recipient mobile number in international format without +, e.g. 31612345678.

originator.description: Sender: alphanumeric up to 11 characters, or a phone number in E.164 digits up to 14 digits.

encoding.description: plain = GSM 03.38 characters only, unicode = any character, auto = Spryng chooses.

route.description: Route id from Spryng, or the default business route.

scheduled_at.description: Send at this time instead of now.

reference.description: Your own reference for this message.

tools.name: spryng_cancel_message
tools.title: Cancel scheduled message
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled message before Spryng sends it. A message already sent cannot be cancelled.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Spryng
prompts.description: What you can do with Spryng here, with example requests to try.
